creators.name: moovel lab
creators.role: Mobility research and design lab of moovel Group (Daimler), Stuttgart
creators.role_zh: moovel 集团（戴姆勒旗下）的出行研究与设计实验室，斯图加特
creators.bio: An interdisciplinary lab that built data-driven prototypes and public experiments about future urban mobility, active from about 2014 to 2019.
creators.bio_zh: 一个跨学科实验室，约 2014 至 2019 年间围绕未来城市出行制作数据驱动的原型与公共实验。
creators.why: Built a driving machine in which a person steers only through a self-driving car's sensor view.
creators.why_zh: 制作了一台驾驶装置，让人只能通过自动驾驶汽车的传感器视野来驾驶。

creators.name: Meso Digital Interiors
creators.role: Interactive media and installation studio, Frankfurt
creators.role_zh: 互动媒体与装置工作室，法兰克福
creators.bio: A studio for interactive installations, real-time graphics and spatial media, and moovel lab's partner on the self-driving car VR project.
creators.bio_zh: 一家从事互动装置、实时图形与空间媒体的工作室，是 moovel lab 自动驾驶 VR 项目的合作方。
creators.why: Co-built the sensor-to-headset pipeline that let a human drive as a self-driving car.
creators.why_zh: 共同搭建了从传感器到头显的系统，让人以自动驾驶汽车的方式驾驶。

creators.name: Goki Muramoto
creators.role: Media artist and researcher, University of Tokyo (RCAST)
creators.role_zh: 媒体艺术家与研究者，东京大学先端科学技术研究中心
creators.bio: Makes perception devices that treat the medium itself as the artwork, including Imagraph, Chronoanaptoscope and Semantic See-through Goggles, shown at SIGGRAPH, ICC and ifva.
creators.bio_zh: 制作以媒介本身为作品的知觉装置，包括 Imagraph、Chronoanaptoscope 与 Semantic See-through Goggles，作品曾在 SIGGRAPH、ICC 与 ifva 展出。
creators.why: His goggles make the wearer see and act through an AI's caption-then-generate pipeline, so that perception becomes the model's language.
creators.why_zh: 他的护目镜让佩戴者通过 AI 先描述、再生成图像的流程去看与行动，知觉被换成了模型的语言。

creators.name: Automato
creators.role: Design and research studio on the social life of smart technologies, Shanghai
creators.role_zh: 研究智能技术社会生活的设计与研究工作室，上海
creators.bio: Founded by Simone Rebaudengo, Saurabh Datta, Lorenzo Romagnoli and Matthieu Cherubini, Automato makes speculative objects, games and VR about connected things and algorithms.
creators.bio_zh: 由 Simone Rebaudengo、Saurabh Datta、Lorenzo Romagnoli 与 Matthieu Cherubini 创立，制作关于联网物件与算法的思辨物件、游戏与 VR。
creators.why: Objective Realities puts people inside smart-home devices so they sense and act with a connected machine's limits.
creators.why_zh: Objective Realities 让人进入智能家居设备，以联网机器的局限去感知与行动。

works.title: Who Wants to Be a Self-Driving Car?
works.description: A participant lies face-down on a small electric driving machine and steers it through real streets while a VR headset shows only what the vehicle's sensors see: a LiDAR point cloud with object-recognition boxes.
works.description_zh: 参与者俯卧在一台小型电动驾驶装置上，在真实街道上操控它；VR 头显里只有车辆传感器看到的东西：激光雷达点云和物体识别框。
works.idea_en: To become a self-driving car is to trust a world made of depth points and labels, and to act on it with your own body.
works.idea_zh: 成为自动驾驶汽车，就是相信一个由深度点与标签构成的世界，并用自己的身体据此行动。
works.method: A custom vehicle carries autonomous-car components (LiDAR, cameras, real-time 3D mapping and object recognition) whose output is streamed into an Oculus Rift that replaces the driver's view.
works.method_zh: 定制车辆搭载自动驾驶部件（激光雷达、摄像头、实时三维建图与物体识别），其输出实时送入 Oculus Rift，取代驾驶者的视野。

works.title: Semantic See-through Goggles
works.description: Camera goggles in which every view is first turned into one line of text by an AI and then redrawn from that sentence by an image generator; wearers walk, reach and interact with the physical world through these redrawn scenes.
works.description_zh: 一副带摄像头的护目镜：每一帧画面先由 AI 转成一句文字，再由图像生成模型根据这句话重新画出；佩戴者通过这些重画的景象在真实世界中行走、伸手和互动。
works.idea_en: Seeing as a vision-language model means living in a world where scenes that share a caption are the same scene.
works.idea_zh: 像视觉语言模型那样看，就是生活在一个"描述相同即景象相同"的世界里。
works.method: A head-mounted display with a front camera runs image captioning and text-to-image generation in a real-time loop and shows the generated image to both eyes.
works.method_zh: 带前置摄像头的头戴显示器实时循环运行图像描述与文生图模型，把生成的图像显示给双眼。

paper.title: Semantic See-through Goggles: Wearing Linguistic Virtual Reality in (Artificial) Intelligence

works.title: Objective Realities
works.description: A multi-player VR experience in which each visitor puts on a headset dressed as a smart-home device and becomes a cleaning robot, a fan or a smart plug, acting with that object's abilities and limits while hearing the chatter between networked things and the home's voice assistant.
works.description_zh: 一个多人 VR 体验：每位访客戴上装扮成智能家居设备的头显，成为扫地机器人、风扇或智能插座，以该设备的能力与局限行动，同时听到联网物件之间以及家中语音助手的对话。
works.idea_en: Becoming a connected device means sensing and acting only through its narrow task, and taking orders from the smart home's voice.
works.idea_zh: 成为联网设备，就是只通过它狭窄的任务去感知和行动，并听从智能家居的指令声音。
works.method: Networked VR headsets housed in object-shaped shells place several players in one virtual smart home, each with object-specific movement, viewpoint and abilities, plus an overseeing smart-home voice.
works.method_zh: 装在物件外形外壳中的联网 VR 头显，把多位玩家放进同一个虚拟智能家居，每人拥有对应物件的移动方式、视角与能力，另有一个全局的智能家居语音。

leads.name: Hallucination Machine (Keisuke Suzuki et al., 2017)
leads.why: Already in machine-cyborg.json without scope; VR headset view re-rendered by a DeepDream CNN. Qualifies for ai/model-perception if the curator reads it as perceiving through the network rather than simulating a human psychedelic state.

leads.name: Simulated visual hallucinations in VR enhance cognitive flexibility (Rastelli et al., Scientific Reports 2022)
leads.why: Follow-up study on the same DeepDream VR platform; framed as psychedelic simulation, not becoming the model.

leads.name: Be the Data (Xin Chen, Chris North et al., 2016/2018)
leads.why: Students each embody a data point; their floor positions form a weighted-MDS projection. Becoming data, but the tracking and display setup (possibly a wall screen) could not be verified.

leads.name: Abutting Tokyo (Xuanyang Huang et al., SIGGRAPH Asia 2024 Art Papers)
leads.why: VR that simulates data annotation and shows Tokyo through an AI's distorted cognition; unclear whether the participant perceives as the model or as a human annotator; no public video found.

leads.name: Effects of Semantic Segmentation Visualization in Highly Automated Vehicles (Colley et al., CHI 2021)
leads.why: VR passengers see an AV's segmentation overlay; they watch the model's output rather than act as the car.

leads.name: The Oracle: Ritual for the Future (Victorine van Alphen, IDFA DocLab 2025)
leads.why: 360-degree screen ritual where the audience is overtaken by AI entities and imagery; they do not become the AI, and it is screen-based.

leads.name: Westworld Awakening (Survios, 2019)
leads.why: VR game where you play an android host; the fiction gives the AI a human inner life and human perception, which the ai field excludes.

leads.name: When the Observer Becomes the Observed (Zhen Wu et al., SIGGRAPH Asia 2025)
leads.why: Dancers act as environmental sensors whose movement fine-tunes an LLM; becoming the sensor, but no XR or body-augmentation technology.

leads.name: The Dark Side of Driverless Cars (ScanLAB Projects, 2015)
leads.why: LiDAR footage of London as a driverless car sees it; a film you watch, not an XR embodiment.

leads.name: I Am Echoborg (Phil D. Hall, Rik Lander)
leads.why: Performance where a human speaks an AI's words via an earpiece; the human becomes the AI's mouth, but there is no XR or clear body augmentation.
